cases.rationale: Zero arguments is the lower invalid arity boundary
preconditions: Published 1.0.0 CLI has the independently verified release SHA-256
steps: Execute the pinned JDK with the published CLI JAR and literal args: []
cases.expected: exit_code = 2; stdout empty; stderr = 'product-test: usage: product-test run --request <request.json>\n'

cases.rationale: Five command arguments exceeds the exact four-argument grammar
preconditions: Published 1.0.0 CLI has the independently verified release SHA-256
steps: Execute the pinned JDK with the published CLI JAR and literal args: ['product-test', 'run', '--request', '/nonexistent-project-test-request', 'extra']
cases.expected: exit_code = 2; stdout empty; stderr = 'product-test: usage: product-test run --request <request.json>\n'

cases.rationale: A readable request must still require deployment configuration
preconditions: Published 1.0.0 CLI has the independently verified release SHA-256
steps: Execute the pinned JDK with the published CLI JAR and literal args: ['product-test', 'run', '--request', '/workspace/ship-evidence/project-workflow/request-input.json']
cases.expected: exit_code = 2; stdout empty; stderr = 'product-test: Missing deployment binding: SWARM_PRODUCT_TEST_FRAMEWORK_JAR\n'

scope_note: Published CLI packaging and invocation slice, two existing AC restated from README/source. Not business/SIT/whole-product coverage.

technique_notes.equivalence: No command vs syntactically valid unbound request are distinct classes
technique_notes.state: No persistent state transition in this slice
technique_notes.regression: All cases target the published standalone entry added to PR1 distribution checks

sut_provenance.source_equivalence: src/main/java and pom.xml have zero diff to the frozen project context revision
